SECOND AMENDMENT TO CREDIT AGREEMENT

"Covenant Relief Period" means the period commencing on the Second Amendment Effective Date and ending on the date on which the Borrower delivers to the Administrative Agent a compliance certificate for the fiscal quarter ending June 30, 2026.

(a) Maximum Leverage Ratio. Permit the Leverage Ratio as of the end of any fiscal quarter to exceed (i) 5.75 to 1.00 for the fiscal quarter ending June 30, 2025.

During the Covenant Relief Period, the Borrower shall not make any Restricted Payment in respect of the repurchase of its Equity Interests, other than Permitted Common Dividend Payments.

An Event of Default shall exist if the Borrower fails to observe any covenant contained in Section 7.11.
